key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded inline `d.set(nullptr)`, which can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown, and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard at the qcollator call site. (B) adds QThreadStorageData::clear() with that guard built in, so the new public API is unconditionally safe to call during shutdown, and the collator workaround can drop its private qthread_p.h dependency.
